purpose: Verified per-building corrections only. Imported OpenStreetMap data remains in malate-map.json and is never overwritten by this file.
source_policy: Only add a building override when its OSM way ID and the correction are supported by a reliable source such as an attributable field photo, official building source, or compatible open map data. Record the source and verification date for every entry.

fields.wall: Optional wall color as CSS hex
fields.trim: Optional trim color as CSS hex
fields.glass: Optional glazing color as CSS hex
fields.accent: Optional signage/accent color as CSS hex
fields.source_url: Source supporting the building-specific correction; required for curated overrides
fields.verified_date: Date the correction was checked, YYYY-MM-DD; required for curated overrides
